nuggets.text: Dan Mullen was the offensive coordinator for Florida's national championship teams in 2006 and 2008.
Dan Mullen coached Heisman winner Tim Tebow at Florida and Dak Prescott at Mississippi State.
Dan Mullen played tight end at Ursinus College, earning first-team All-Centennial Conference honors as a senior.
Saturday is a homecoming for Jackson Arnold, whose high school is about 10 minutes from North Texas.
Jackson Arnold was the Gatorade national player of the year at Guyer High School in Denton.
Jackson Arnold is on his third team in three seasons: Oklahoma, Auburn and now the Rebels.
Tre Fulton made 12 tackles at Hawaii and was named Mountain West Defensive Player of the Week.
Kal-El Togafau had two sacks at Hawaii and was named the Mountain West Freshman of the Week.
The Rebels held Hawaii to six points, the fewest UNLV has allowed to Hawaii in a series dating to 1969.
The Fremont Cannon, UNLV's rivalry prize with Nevada, weighs 545 pounds, the heaviest trophy in college football.
